name: Edit Fields (Set)
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: Use the Edit Fields node to set workflow data. This node can set new data as well as overwrite data that already exists. This node is crucial in workflows which expect incoming data from previous nodes, such as when inserting values to Google Sheets or databases

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: You can either use Manual Mapping to edit fields using the GUI or JSON Output to write JSON that n8n adds to the input data

parameters.name: Fields to Set
parameters.description: If you select Mode > Manual Mapping, you can configure the fields by dragging and dropping values from INPUT
options: n8n sets the value's name as the field name
The field value contains an expression which accesses the value

parameters.name: Keep Only Set Fields
parameters.description: Enable this to discard any input data that you don't use in Fields to Set

parameters.name: Include in Output
parameters.description: Choose which input data to include in the node's output data

parameters.name: Include Binary Data
parameters.description: If the input data includes binary data, choose whether to include it in the Edit Fields node's output data

parameters.name: Support Dot Notation
parameters.description: By default, n8n supports dot notation
